title: Plug-tray vacuum seed head
engineering: 72-hole drill schedules and ideal-seal retention model. Larger hole gives 4.81× modeled load versus 1.64× for the first revision.
physical_check: Measure tray and seed lot. Run ten trays and require at least 90% single fills.

title: Tray dibble press
engineering: 24-tip schedule and depth error model. Revised brace reduces the maximum modeled error from 4.521 mm to 1.280 mm.
physical_check: Check 24 depths within 2 mm and inspect for cracks after 50 cycles.

title: Seed roller metering test stand
engineering: Optical gate counted 100 of 100 spaced synthetic drops and 50 of 100 in close pairs.
physical_check: Count at least 98 of 100 opaque seed drops verified by video and report the overlap limit.

title: Filter differential pressure panel
engineering: Zero-flow pressure sweep and gauge tolerance budget. Revised maximum bound is 0.0349 bar versus 0.0949 bar.
physical_check: Bench-equalize both ports within component ratings. Verify zero within 0.05 bar and check for leaks.

title: Soil tension recorder
engineering: Reversed-polarity ADC model returned 0.147% worst resistance error. The fixed-temperature control differed by up to 11.028 kPa.
physical_check: Check five resistance references and a field sensor wet/dry cycle with a colocated temperature probe.

title: Leaf-wetness duration node
engineering: Three-sample confirmation emitted 20 matching edges and an explicit data gap. Single-sample control emitted 60 edges.
physical_check: Check ten controlled transitions within two minutes against a timed wetness reference.

title: Soil core ejector sampler
engineering: Ejector dimensions and Euler check. Digital buckling limit rises from 111.7 N to 1881 N with 0.60 mm shoe clearance.
physical_check: Recover five cores within 10% of insertion length and record actual ejection force.

title: Water clarity disk with line reel
engineering: 200 mm quadrants plus 50-mark line check. Revised worst assumed loaded error is 12 mm versus 52 mm.
physical_check: Compare marks against a 5 m tape under load and compare repeated clarity readings in still water.

title: Depth-selective water grab sampler
engineering: One-litre chamber sizing and tracer balance. Modeled worst crossover falls from 44.87% to 5.09% with longer hold.
physical_check: Verify closure and repeat five layered-water trials with crossover below 10%.

title: Hatchery fish length board
engineering: 401-tick SVG. Ten model stations predict 0.600 mm worst error with compensation and 2.598 mm without it.
physical_check: Check the installed scale up to 400 mm against a steel rule within 1 mm.

title: Green coffee size sieve stack
engineering: Two perforation SVGs retain 2.55 mm minimum modeled web with kerf compensation versus 2.37 mm without it.
physical_check: Gauge ten holes per plate and mass-balance a known 250 g mix to within 1%.

title: Green coffee sample riffle divider
engineering: Alternating chute schedule and ten bead simulations. Worst half-mass error is 4.20% with uniform feed versus 11.40% with skewed feed.
physical_check: Use ten 1 kg bead splits with each half within 5% of target and report color fractions.
